cards.text: Jesus has just finished a whole run of parables, so He leaves that place and teaches the people in the synagogue of His hometown. They are astonished. You know when somebody you've known forever suddenly says something brilliant, and your first thought isn't "wow," it's "wait, since WHEN?"

cards.question: Listening to Jesus in the synagogue, what are the hometown people asking?

answers.text: Where His wisdom and powers came from
When He will heal the sick in town
How long He plans to stay in town

cards.text: Then they start listing what they already know about Him. They name His mother, Mary, and His brothers, James, Joseph, Simon and Judas, like they're flipping through His family photo album OUT LOUD.

cards.question: The hometown crowd asks whether Jesus isn't the ___'s son.

cards.text: They point out that all His sisters are right there with them too. And after all that, they land right back where they started: "Where then did this man get all these things?"

cards.question: After all their questions, the hometown crowd honors Jesus.

cards.text: They take offense at Him. Jesus answers them with one short line about a prophet and honor, and friend, that one line LANDS.

cards.question: According to Jesus, where is a prophet without honor?

answers.text: Only in his hometown and his own household
Only in big cities and royal courts

cards.text: And in the end, Jesus does not do many miracles there in His hometown.

cards.question: Why doesn't Jesus do many miracles in His hometown?
